title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.

title: Senior collections policy analyst
description:
Senior Collections Policy AnalystWhat You'll Do
Analyze the behavior of customers with short-, medium-, and long-term delinquencies to identify opportunities for improvement;
Create and refine data-driven collections policies to reduce risk and increase recovery;
Use SQL and Python to extract insights and generate strategic reports;
Explain to the business and sales teams why analytical strategies work and demonstrate the value of the solutions;
Work closely with the Data Science and Operations teams.
What we're looking for
Experience: Previous experience with data analysis focused on collections or credit risk;
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Big Query, and Python;
Practical Approach: Ability to translate numbers into actions that solve customer problems;
Communication: Ability to explain complex results in a simple way to different teams;
Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.
Differentiators
Knowledge of discount policies, portfolio write-offs, and pricing
English
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Analista Sénior de Políticas de Cobranças
O que irá fazer
Analisar o comportamento dos clientes com incumprimentos a curto, médio e longo prazo para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
Criar e aperfeiçoar políticas de cobranças baseadas em dados para reduzir o risco e aumentar a recuperação;
Utilizar SQL e Python para extrair insights e gerar relatórios estratégicos;
Explicar às equipas comerciais e de vendas por que razão as estratégias analíticas funcionam e demonstrar o valor das soluções;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Ciência de Dados e Operações.
O que procuramos
Experiência: Experiência anterior em análise de dados focada em cobranças ou risco de crédito;
Competências técnicas: Proficiência em SQL, Big Query e Python;
Abordagem prática: Capacidade de traduzir números em ações que resolvam os problemas dos clientes;
Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar resultados complexos de forma simples a diferentes equipas;
Formação: Licenciatura em Matemática, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.
Diferenciais
Conhecimento de políticas de descontos, baixas de carteira e precificação;
Inglês.

title: Arquiteto
description:
Estamos em busca de um arquiteto/a ou engenheiro/a com perfil prático e organizado para atuar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos voltados para marcenaria e serralheria.
Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar projetos em execução real, conectando o cliente, o projeto e a produção, garantindo que tudo aconteça com clareza, qualidade e dentro do prazo.
Para ter sucesso nessa função, é essencial ter domínio técnico, boa comunicação e capacidade de organização, já que o trabalho envolve desde medições em obra até detalhamento executivo e acompanhamento da produção.
Essa posição é fundamental para garantir que os projetos saiam do papel com precisão e que a experiência do cliente seja consistente ao longo de todo o processo.
RESPONSABILIDADES
Planejar e desenvolver projetos de marcenaria e serralheria
Realizar medições in loco para levantamento técnico
Elaborar desenhos executivos detalhados para produção
Acompanhar obras e instalações, garantindo aderência ao projeto
Fazer a gestão e o acompanhamento da produção junto às equipes
Atuar como ponte entre cliente e setores internos (produção, logística e atendimento)
Organizar e documentar informações dos projetos em relatórios
Identificar ajustes e melhorias durante a execução dos projetos
QUALIFICAÇÕ ES
Formação em Arquitetura e Urbanismo
Domínio de desenho técnico e detalhamento executivo
Organização e atenção a detalhes
Boa comunicação e capacidade de gestão de processos
Proatividade para resolver problemas em obra e produção
DIFERENCIAIS
Experiência com marcenaria e/ou serralheria
Experiência com acompanhamento de obra
Domínio de softwares como Sketch Up, Auto CAD ou similares
Experiência com compatibilização de projetos e produção

description:
A BAIA Labs é uma consultoria de tecnologia que oferece soluções de comunicação, marketing e integração de IA. Nosso projeto mais recente é a "BAIA Influencers", uma agência de criadores de conteúdo no estado da Bahia.

Visitar e prospectar clientes, gerentes de negócios e proprietários de lojas na cidade de Salvador.
Atualizar os bancos de dados de clientes e criadores em Excel, recrutar candidatos e manter comunicação constante.
Facilitar o processo operacional de produção de conteúdo.
Pesquisar e implementar novas ferramentas para otimizar processos. Os requisitos da vaga são os seguintes:
Experiência profissional em uma das seguintes áreas: Comunicação, Marketing, Administração ou Vendas.
Domínio de: Excel, Engenharia de Prompt para modelos de IA (Chat GPT, Gemini, etc.) e Canva para apresentações online.
Possuir computador próprio.
Residir em Salvador, Bahia.

title: Python tech lead - remote work
description: At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work. Overview of the role: We are looking for Python Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry! These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc. Key responsibilities:- Work closely alongside their Engineering and Business Stakeholders to support the delivery of the project. - Be able to manage your time effectively to focus on coding as well as supporting junior members. - Integrate with the Dev Ops team to maintain tasks. - Make architectural decisions keeping the future of a growing business in mind. Requirements:- 7+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development. - Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable. - 3 years of development using other programming languages. - Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / My SQL). - Experience with OOD. - Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms. - A University Degree in systems is a plus. - Advanced English level. Benefits: - Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation. - Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals. - Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity. - Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance. - Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation. - Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment. - Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth. - Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement. If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de marketing | eventos e parcerias institucionais
description: Sobre a empresa Na Morada.ai,  a revolução imobiliária está a todo vapor !  A Morada.ai é uma empresa especializada em  inteligência artificial aplicada ao mercado imobiliário.  Nossa principal solução, a  MIA (Morada Inteligência Artificial) , é uma  assistente digital personalizada que otimiza o processo de vendas para incorporadoras,  oferecendo funcionalidades como simulação de financiamentos, coleta de documentos, e agendamento de visitas.  A MIA integra-se com CRMs, fornece  inteligência de marketing  por meio de dashboards, e melhora a conversão de leads, reduzindo custos e recuperando leads descartados, oferecendo uma experiência contínua e eficaz para os clientes. Nossa Missão:  ser ponte de transformação, aceleração e otimização na forma de fazer negócios no mercado imobiliário por meio da tecnologia.  Nosso propósito:  transformar a jornada de compra e locação de imóveis no mercado brasileiro.  Atendemos uma ampla gama de clientes no setor imobiliário, desde pequenas incorporadoras até grandes empresas nacionais. Atualmente, quase 100 incorporadoras em 17 estados do Brasil confiam em nossa tecnologia, incluindo nomes de peso como Direcional, Cyrela, e Patrimar/Novolar. Com a MIA, já realizamos quase meio milhão de atendimentos, trocando mais de 12 milhões de mensagens.  Este ano, nosso crescimento foi de mais de 400% em comparação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, demonstrando a eficácia e a escalabilidade de nossa solução.  Recentemente, recebemos um aporte de R$6 milhões liderado pela Nexus Empreendimentos, destacando nosso potencial de inovação e confiança no mercado. Este investimento nos permitirá continuar expandindo nossas operações e melhorando nossas soluções, mantendo-nos na vanguarda da tecnologia no mercado imobiliário.  Pilares da nossa Cultura:

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Company Description
Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.
Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.
Role Description
As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.
In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.
With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.
Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.
Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.
Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.
Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.
Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.
Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.
Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.
Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.
Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.
Qualifications
Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.
Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.
Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.
Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.
Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.
Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Sap S/4hana Finance Consultant
description: Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world's leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client's operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.Duties and Responsibilities:The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client's financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operationsMinimum Qualifications/Experience: 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery modelsMinimum Education:Bachelor's Degree – Preferred Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).Required Certifications:Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.Other:Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.G., LATAM delivery centers) Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:
OGrupo Fleuryé uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Principais atividades:Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.Buscamos alguém que apresente:Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)Conhecimento específicos:Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurançaAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executem otrabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidade epaternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Wordpress Developer
description: MoveUp Media We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in France, Brazil & India, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our Approach We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. The technical side is key to achieve a seamless experience for all, thus you will be at the heart of all key projects for MoveUp Media. Our team has a central platform to facilitate a well organized approach.The Role As a WordPress developer, you will be responsible for: Working inside our custom WordPress engine (themes, plugins, internal tools). Build and maintain advanced Gutenberg blocks, leveraging hooks, APIs, and custom theme logic. Optimize database queries and code execution (profiling, debugging, chasing wasted milliseconds and memory leaks). Integrate with REST APIs and support complex integrations/microservices. Work daily in Docker/Podman environments (WP-CLI, container operations, Linux commands). Collaborate with front-end integrators to connect blocks/themes while owning the backend architecture.Required Skills To excel in this role, you will need to master the following skills: Deep expertise in PHP and the WordPress ecosystem (hooks, APIs, plugins, themes, Gutenberg). Strong SQL skills and proven experience optimizing queries for performance. Solid understanding of REST APIs and microservice integration patterns. React experience, especially for Gutenberg block development. Comfortable with Docker/Podman workflows and Linux environments (WP-CLI, file manipulation, container ops). A performance-minded developer: profiling, measuring, and optimizing code execution. MacOS or Linux development environment (mandatory). Good command of HTML, CSS (SCSS), and JavaScript (ES6). Experience working closely with designers and front-end integrators. Awareness of accessibility and Core Web Vitals best practices.The ideal profile We are looking for a professional with over 4 years of experience in web development and WordPress. You must be meticulous and detail-oriented, while having a strong team spirit and the ability to take initiative. Autonomy and a passion for technology will be major assets, as well as a focus on quality and application performance.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements, followed by a possible technical test 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for you A full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Attractive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location. Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly Workation — a mix of work and vacation. Once a year, we find a cool place to work and have fun together.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future!

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking SpecialistAdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.What You'll Be Doing
- Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch readiness.
- Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.
- Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.
- Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented correctly and on time.
- Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.
- Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.
- Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.Whats You Bring
- 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).
- Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic advertising.
- Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.
- Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.
- Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.What We Offer Competitive salary (dependent on region) Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits Unlimited PTO Flexible, remote-first culture Coworking space allowance Gym membership reimbursement Mobile phone plan reimbursement Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations
description:
Company Description RxDiet is a healthcare technology company that provides medically tailored groceries and clinical behavioral health interventions for patients. Our proprietary artificial intelligence and national grocery retail integrations allow us to deliver these solutions to patients, meeting them where they are. Our mission is to empower members' healthcare journeys by unlocking the full potential of food as medicine.Role Description We are looking for a Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations to take ownership of our integrations with third-party retailers in the United States. You will work closely with the engineering and devops team. This is a do-it-all role, and we need an individual who wants to get their hands dirty. This role is full-time remote.What we are looking for: 3–5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience, with Kotlin as the primary language;
strong Java experience is considered if paired with a genuine interest in adopting Kotlin. Solid experience with Spring Boot and production-grade application development. Strong command of authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, token lifecycle management) across a range of integration architectures. Proficiency working with both REST and GraphQL APIs, including handling underdocumented or evolving third-party interfaces. Experience designing and working within microservices architectures, including asynchronous communication via Apache ActiveMQ. Hands-on experience with frontend reverse engineering and web scraping, including browser automation tools such as Puppeteer or Playwright. Experience integrating with grocery or food retailer APIs (order management, product catalogs, availability, or fulfillment) is a strong competitive advantage. General AWS knowledge including S3, and familiarity with core AWS services and best practices. General frontend knowledge and familiarity with modern frameworks (React, Vue, or similar). Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively. Ready to respond to outages and troubleshoot issues quickly when things break. It's a bonus if you're interested in food-as-medicine, startups, or community health.Our PerksCompetitive salary structure. Full flexibility for remote work (Work from anywhere). One annual company-wide offsite event. Unlimited time off policy. Be an integral part of a supportive, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.RxDiet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and strives to create a diverse and inclusive environment. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and are committed to non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
