title: Arquiteto De Software
description: AVMetrixé uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Softwareé responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataformaVMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.Responsabilidades Principais:Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura:Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico:Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão:Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.Por que trabalhar na VMetrix NaVMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, aVMetrixé o lugar.

title: Senior Java Developer
description: AVMetrixé uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.Propósito do Cargo ComoSenior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade:preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA:você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design:você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico:considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership:leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade:se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara:escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura:Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

Atuará na automação de monitoramento via IaC, integração com pipelines DevOps e na definição de métricas de confiabilidade (SLO/SLI/SLA) para aplicações críticas. Será responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery e Change Failure Rate), promovendo uma cultura orientada a dados e melhoria contínua na entrega de software.Requisitos: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights. Coleta e correlação de logs, métricas e traces. Observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Functions, Logic Apps, App Services). Observabilidade de containers e clusters AKS (Kubernetes). Criação de dashboards e alertas personalizados (KQL, Workbooks, Grafana). Integração de Application Insights com pipelines DevOps e ferramentas de APM. Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM) e rastreamento distribuído. Conceitos de SLA, SLO e SLI e aplicação prática em ambientes produtivos. Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM) para provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade. Automação de alertas e incidentes com Logic Apps, Azure Functions e Webhooks. Conhecimento de containers, Kubernetes, Helm e Prometheus. Métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) e integração com pipelines DevOps.Benefícios e Incentivos: Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics or DatadogOnde você vai trabalhar? title: Engenheiro De Ia - Sênior
description: Descrição da vaga A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes. Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes. Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos. Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI). Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente. Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas. Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções. Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders. Requisitos e qualificações: Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning. Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas). Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI). Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas. Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).Diferenciais: Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT). Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines. Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description: About SEW SEW.Ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas, Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.Ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX), Workforce Experience (WX), Payment Experience (PX), Intelligent Experience (iX), Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.Quick Highlights 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizationsSEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.Role Summary TheProduct Solutions Engineeris a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.Ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.This role requires approximately30% travelto support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.Key Responsibilities Client Engagement & Solution Consulting Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements. Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards. Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation. Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases. Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.Product & Architecture Alignment Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights. Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy. Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings. Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness. Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success. Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance. Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.Process Optimization & Innovation Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization. Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.Required Qualifications Previous experiencein aclient-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role. Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities. Experience providingindustry best practice recommendationswithin the Energy and Utilities sector. Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations. Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities. Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations). Ability to work effectively as anindividual contributorwhile influencing global cross-functional teams. Willingness to travel approximately30% .Preferred Technical Background Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures. Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#. Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho: Atuar em Change Management de ambientes SAP globais, garantindo o controle, governança e execução de mudanças em múltiplos sistemas e landscapes. Dar suporte ao modelo Follow The Sun (FTS), incluindo janelas de migração, change freeze, upgrades e atividades de refresh. Utilizar ferramentas como SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, Focused Build e STMS para gerenciar e movimentar transportes entre diversos ambientes. Garantir a estabilidade e integridade dos sistemas SAP por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de change management. Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes relacionados a mudanças, além de apoiar times globais na coordenação de atividades e agendamentos. Realizar comunicação constante com stakeholders técnicos e funcionais em diferentes regiões. Participar de atividades de melhoria contínua, Disaster Recovery e suporte on-call em regime global.O que você precisa ter: Inglês avançado/fluente Experiência com processos de Change Management em ambientes SAP Conhecimento em SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, Focused Build e STMS Capacidade analítica e forte habilidade na resolução de problemas Perfil organizado, proativo e orientado a processos e prazos Habilidade de comunicação com times globais e múltiplos stakeholders Capacidade de atuar em ambiente ágil e sob pressão Conhecimento em gestão de múltiplos ambientes SAP e transport layers Disponibilidade para suporte on-call e atuação em janelas globaisSerá um destaque seu perfil com: Experiência em ambientes SAP Vivência com modelos Follow The Sun (FTS) Conhecimento em ITIL e práticas de gestão de mudanças Experiência com Disaster Recovery e ambientes críticos Participação em times Agile globais Experiência com automação e otimização de processos de transporte SAP Conhecimento em auditoria e compliance de mudanças em sistemas SAPOnde você vai trabalhar? 100% remoto no conforto da sua casaBenefícios para você Vale Refeição Vale Alimentação Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Seguro de Vida Gym Pass Auxílio PetAlém disso, oferecemos: Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Project Manager
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines: Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. Academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a Senior IT Project Manager with a minimum of 8 years of experience in managing complex IT projects. Experience in driving global XSTORE upgrade projects (preferably V25), enabling standardized retail setups. Strong knowledge of IT project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid), IT change and release management, and process management in regulated environments. Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS PowerPoint, Teams, and preferably Clarity PPM. Solid experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, particularly in billing and interface management. Ability to translate legal and fiscal requirements into IT solutions. Proven experience in coordinating external service providers and system integrators. Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, rhetoric, and presentation skills. PMP or comparable project management certification is highly desirable. Fluent in English (written and spoken). Willingness to travel. Location: Portugal or abroad (Remote from Portugal or abroad options available). Eligibility: Portuguese national, foreign national with existing permission, or foreign national in visa process.What do we have to offer you? Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
Aubay Training Academy,designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
Language platform, withconversation classes in 12 languages;
Working model: remote;
What makes us different?Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
We promote closeness and an informal environment;
Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.Your next adventure starts here! If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step! The future is waiting for you — and so are we!Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

title: Senior Ruby On Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love.About YouYou're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.About the RoleWrite full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture;
writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.Why Work at StayFi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industryin a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Analista De P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++Resumo do Propósito da Função: Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente. Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting). O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.Esta função envolve: Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises. Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual.REQUISITOS:Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang TDD – metodologia de testes Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database. Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.Desejável: Javascript Kubernetes AKS Terraform Monitoring systems Prometheus Stack Messaging (RabbitMQ)O que oferecemos? title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About VoxyVoxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents.If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.You can find additional information about our values at this link ( Impact You'll Have at Voxy Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.What You'll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: - Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols. - Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance. - Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams;
documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system. - Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters;
tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager. - Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger;
investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments. - Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies. - Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies;
prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms. - Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk;
flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior. - Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.Reporting & Analysis: - Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review. - Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends. - Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation. - Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.What We're Looking For: - B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
- Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
- Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
- Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
- Based anywhere in Brazil - Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish - Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.Job Details: - Gross Salary: R$110,500/year - Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy: - Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) - Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events - Remote friendly work policies - Professional development budget - Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify - Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world - Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions;
our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;

description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Product Owner
description: Company Description Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.Intro video:  Backlog & Kanban Management: Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members. Task Definition & Refinement: Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks. Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output: After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.Qualifications Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively. Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities. Prior experience in a similar role is preferred. Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not requiredNotes This is a full-time remote position. Hiring interviews are online.

title: Product Owner
description: A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo.Sobre a posição O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações. Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será: Suporte operacional Manutenção Estabilidade das aplicações Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades.Responsabilidades Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos. Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap. Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega. Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura. Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias. Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio. Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução. Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio. Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas. Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release. Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências. Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints. Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais.Requisitos Experiência como Product Owner Vivência commetodologias ágeis. Inglês avançado/fluente– todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês. Forte capacidade de: Entendimento do negócio Comunicação clara Experiência ou familiaridade com: Zendesk Amazon Connect Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial) Modelo de trabalho Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto Horário:8h às 17h Início:previsão final de Março 2026

title: Analista De Tráfego Pago
description: Localização: Remoto Tipo de contratação: Tempo integralSobre a oportunidade Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Tráfego Pago para apoiar a gestão, execução e monitoramento de campanhas de mídia paga em diferentes plataformas.Esta posição é ideal para profissionais com experiência em campanhas digitais que desejam atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em organização, análise de desempenho e melhoria contínua. Interesse em otimização e melhoria contínua de campanhas.Ambiente de trabalho Modelo remoto. Processos estruturados e suporte interno. Ambiente colaborativo e profissional.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policiesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor riskindicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Build and maintain advanced Gutenberg blocks, leveraging hooks, APIs, and custom theme logic. Optimize database queries and code execution (profiling, debugging, chasing wasted milliseconds and memory leaks). Integrate with REST APIs and support complex integrations/microservices. Collaborate with front-end integrators to connect blocks/themes while owning the backend architecture.Required Skills To excel in this role, you will need to master the following skills: Deep expertise in PHP and the WordPress ecosystem (hooks, APIs, plugins, themes, Gutenberg). Strong SQL skills and proven experience optimizing queries for performance. Solid understanding of REST APIs and microservice integration patterns. React experience, especially for Gutenberg block development. Comfortable with Docker/Podman workflows and Linux environments (WP-CLI, file manipulation, container ops). A performance-minded developer: profiling, measuring, and optimizing code execution. MacOS or Linux development environment (mandatory). Good command of HTML, CSS (SCSS), and JavaScript (ES6). Experience working closely with designers and front-end integrators. Awareness of accessibility and Core Web Vitals best practices.The ideal profile We are looking for a professional with over 4 years of experience in web development and WordPress. You must be meticulous and detail-oriented, while having a strong team spirit and the ability to take initiative. Autonomy and a passion for technology will be major assets, as well as a focus on quality and application performance.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements, followed by a possible technical test 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for you A full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Attractive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location. Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly Workation — a mix of work and vacation. Once a year, we find a cool place to work and have fun together.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future!

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: Position Overview: As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‐generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‐first operations, and AI‐driven decision‐making across the organization.You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.Responsibilities: Administers day‐to‐day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance. Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams. Partners with cross‐functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements. Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows. Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements. Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health. Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps. Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‐powered workflow automations. Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‐channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations. Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience. Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling. Ensures secure, least‐privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs. Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment. Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement. Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools. Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‐scaling teams. Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‐to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.Position Requirements: 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‐level or high‐velocity environment. Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred. Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.Additional Requirements: Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture. Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred). Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics. Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‐functional GTM operations. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations. Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential). Hands‐on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‐moving, high‐growth environment.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
