This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.What You'll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: - Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols. - Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance. - Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams;
documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system. - Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters;
tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager. - Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger;
investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments. - Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies. - Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies;
prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms. - Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk;
flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior. - Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.Reporting & Analysis: - Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review. - Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends. - Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation. - Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.What We're Looking For: - B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
- Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
- Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
- Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
- Based anywhere in Brazil - Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish - Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.Job Details: - Gross Salary: R$110,500/year - Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy: - Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) - Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events - Remote friendly work policies - Professional development budget - Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify - Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world - Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions;
our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. You'll work closely with engineering and platform teams to ensure our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and maintainable. This is a highly collaborative role suited for someone who enjoys balancing delivery with operational excellence in a fast-moving environment.What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure‐as‐code practices Support and improve Kubernetes-based platforms, containerized workloads, and CI/CD pipelines Build and operate AWS-based infrastructure using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AWS Transfer Family, RDS, and S3 Partner with engineering teams to improve reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency Support identity and access workflows, including SAML-based integrations Contribute to technical documentation, design decisions, and operational runbooks Prioritize and manage work in a Kanban-style operational environment with competing demandsWhat We're Looking For Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and networking fundamentals Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD systems in real-world environments Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, including modules, state management, and multi-environment deployments Solid understanding of operational concerns such as system reliability, scalability, security, and cost Experience building and supporting AWS infrastructure Experience using GitHub Actions to support CI/CD workflows Strong understanding of identity concepts, including authentication, authorization, and SAML Strong written communication skills, especially for technical documentation and design explanations Ability to prioritize work effectively and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneouslyNice to Have Experience with tools such as Netlify, Okta, Apache Kafka, or Redis Background working on platform or developer enablement teams Experience supporting infrastructure in regulated or compliance-focused environments

title: Analista De P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++Resumo do Propósito da Função: Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente. Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting). O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.Esta função envolve: Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises. Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual.REQUISITOS:Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang TDD – metodologia de testes Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database. Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.Desejável: Javascript Kubernetes AKS Terraform Monitoring systems Prometheus Stack Messaging (RabbitMQ)O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atuaSe o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE? We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!CloudSEK,one of India's most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world's fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we've grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:CloudSEK's Product Suite: CloudSEKXVigilconstantly maps a customer's digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoringtool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers' attack surfaces. CloudSEK'sBeVigiluses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK's Contextual AISVigilidentifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones: 2016 : Launched our first product. 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's\ "Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.Role Overview: As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK's products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.Your mission->
I. Account Management: Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs. II. Cybersecurity Expertise: Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK's platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK's solutions. III. Customer Engagement: Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery. IV. Revenue Generation and Retention: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK's products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities. V. Product Usage and Feedback: Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. VI. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.What we're looking for: 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value deliveryBenefits of Joining CloudSEK We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You'll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições): Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);

Produzir materiais simples (guias rápidos, FAQs) e registros quando solicitado;
Sinalizar riscos ou inconsistências observadas, encaminhando ao gestor do cliente.Requisitos: Experiência como Consultor SAP Concur;
Graduação completa.Ondevocê vai trabalhar?: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Professor De Francês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICATitle:Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations Company:Fulcrum SaaS Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:Full-time Level:Senior / Staff Compensation:USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and locationAbout Fulcrum SaaS Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable. Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.The Role We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers. You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars. You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.What You'll Do Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements. Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery. Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation. Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise. Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure. Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation. Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.What We're Looking For (Must-Haves) 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better). Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes. Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity. Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable. Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure. Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable. Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate. Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).Strong Nice-to-Haves Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.What We Offer Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices. Direct access to leadership;
your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented. A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting: Your experience with Go in production. The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned. Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Software Engineer(Python+Golang)
description:

title: Ai Agent Manager (Media)

This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.Duties and Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.G., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.G., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts ("blueprints") to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems. Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.Core Requirements 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.G., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience Experience indigital media, advertising tech, or media planning.Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs. Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT. Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative. Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles. Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Software Engineer(Python+Golang)
description:
Title: Software Engineer(Python+Golang) Location: 100% Remote Job Type: ContractRoles and Responsibilities The Software Developer will join a dedicated Virtusa team responsible for managing the end-to-end migration of repositories across a phased timeline. Key responsibilities include:
- Stakeholder Intake & Triage: Communicate directly with engineering teams to identify and catalog all packages released by their projects, using standard ticketing and workflow systems inside Google
- Code & Configuration Migration: Write and implement necessary configuration changes and code updates to route projects through the new secure release gate.
- Phased Milestone Execution: Execute the migration strategy across structured phases, beginning with smaller pilot environments and progressively scaling up to complex, mission-critical internal libraries.
- Reporting: Provide weekly progress updates to Google & Virtusa leadership detailing stakeholder engagement, milestone advancement, and the total count of successfully migrated packages.
- Throughput: Achieve an end-to-end migration of at least 12 agreed repositories per week (expected range of 12-18). Required Skills and QualificationsTechnical Requirements:
- Experience: At least 5+ years of professional software engineering and programming experience.
- Languages: Strong, demonstrable proficiency in Python and Go programming languages.
- Version Control: Hands-on experience working with GitHub and managing repositories at scale.
- Key Differentiator (Highly Desirable): Familiarity with and prior working experience in Google Development Tools, specifically Buganizer and Taskflow. Operational Requirements:
- Location: Must be based in Mexico (Guadalajara) / Brazil (Sao Paulo region)
- Time Zone Overlap: Must maintain working time-zone overlap with US-based Googler teams to facilitate the intake process Thanks Aatmesh

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure:Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means:Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop:Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty:We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation:Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation:Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team:Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

Requerida experiência de 2 anos com desenvolvimento end-to-end, incluindo levantamento de necessidades, implantação, implementação, testes e homologação. Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Sales Cloud ou Service Cloud. Requerida experiência com data modeling e data management no ambiente Salesforce. Requerida experiência com ordem de execução de Triggers (Triggers and Orders of Execution). Requerida experiência com debug logs e Developer Console. Requerida experiência com Apex Testing. Requerida experiência com integrações e desenvolvimento em Apex e .NET Basics. Requerida experiência com Platform Development basics. Requerida experiência com Lightning Experience Development. Requerida experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (ex.: Flosum, Git).Diferenciais que podem te destacar: Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação;
Certificação Salesforcede Administrador/ Desenvolvedor/ Platform App Builder I;
Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.);
Experiência com indicadores de CRM;
Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
Inglês intermediário;
Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos: Trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
Comprometimento e engajamento;
Comunicação eficaz e organização;
Disciplina e foco;
Raciocínio lógico e resolução de problemas;
Proatividade e aprendizado contínuo.Por que se juntar ao nosso time? Ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e inovador;
Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional;
Cultura de colaboração e crescimento conjunto;
Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta.Modelo de contratação: PJ Jornada: 168 horas/mêsSe identificou com essa oportunidade? Então, não perca tempo! Envie seu currículo e venha construir sua história com a gente!

Isso reflete nossas raízes na tecnologia de fibra óptica e nossa visão de liderar o caminho para um futuro mais brilhante e mais conectado.A Lighteraestá com vagas abertas paraOperador(a) de Máquinase busca pessoas comprometidas, que gostem de desafios e desejem evoluir junto com a empresa.Aqui, você fará parte de um ambiente industrial moderno, com foco em segurança, qualidade, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de pessoas.Vaga:Operador(a) de Máquinas Área:Fábrica de Cabos Local:Cidade Industrial de Curitiba Modelo de trabalho:Fixo Horário:Turnos e/ou escala 3x3REQUISITOS: Ensino Médio completo;
Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos e/ou escala 3x3;
Residir em Curitiba ou Região Metropolitana, com fácil acesso à região da CIC;
Conhecimentos básicos de leitura e interpretação de instruções de trabalho e procedimentos operacionais;
Disponibilidade para realização de horas extras, quando necessário.DIFERENCIAIS: Experiência anterior como Operador(a) de Máquinas em ambiente industrial;
Curso de Mecânica Básica Industrial, Processos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua, como 5S, Kaizen, TPM ou Lean Manufacturing;
Experiência com controle de qualidade visual e/ou dimensional;
Vivência em empresas dos segmentos metalúrgico, elétrico ou de cabos/fibras ópticas.ATRIBUIÇÕES: Operar máquinas fixas nos processos de trefilação, binagem, reunião, extrusão de isolamento, capa e tubo, pintura de fibras e fracionamento de cabos ópticos e eletrônicos, conforme os padrões operacionais;
Realizar inspeções durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a conformidade dos produtos com as normas internas de qualidade;
Monitorar os parâmetrosde processo, identificando desvios e comunicando a liderança quando necessário;
Abastecer as máquinas eorganizar os materiais conforme o fluxo produtivo;
Atuar de forma ativa nos programas de Melhoria Contínua, contribuindo para a redução de custos, desperdícios e aumento da produtividade;
Aplicar diariamente os conceitos do Programa 5S;
Utilizar as ferramentase métodos do Sistema de Produção da empresa para a identificação e solução de problemas;
Movimentar materiais utilizando paleteiras manuais ou elétricas, respeitando as normas de segurança;
Zelar pela organização,limpeza e conservação do posto de trabalho e dos equipamentos;
Faça parte de nossa missão de moldar o futuro da conectividade.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description: Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor) **Must send resume in English**Overview: The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.Key Responsibilities:Relationship Management Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time. Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue. Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time. Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up. Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes. Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management. Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.Administrative Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time. Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time. Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation. Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits. Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation. Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement. Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions. Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processingQualifications: Bachelor's degree Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy) Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)Technical Requirements: Fully remote position High-speed, stable internet connection Professional-grade webcam High-quality speakerphone or headset Modern computer with reliable performance Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet softwarePersonal Attributes: Empathetic and active listener Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment Quick thinking and adaptable communication style Patient and persistent in building relationships Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individualsNote: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Senior Data Scientist/Ai Engineer
description:
Role Overview KPIT is seeking a highly skilled, hands-onSenior Data Scientist / AI Engineer(Remote)to architect, develop, and deliver end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem.The successful candidate will be responsible for the entire AI lifecycle—from designing scalable data pipelines to deploying production-grade AI agents capable of complex, multi-step reasoning. This role is ideal for an engineer who excels at bridging the gap between experimental data science and robust, scalable MLOps.Key Responsibilities End-to-End Solution Delivery:Own the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from initial problem definition and data acquisition to production deployment and monitoring. Data Engineering & Pipeline Development:Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Spark on Azure Databricks. Model Development & Feature Engineering:Perform advanced feature engineering, data preparation, and sophisticated model development for diverse business use cases. Agentic AI & GenAI:Develop and deploy AI agents and workflows utilizing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and Generative AI frameworks. MLOps & Lifecycle Management:Implement and manage MLflow for experiment tracking;
monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability in production environments. Cross-Functional Collaboration:Partner with Business, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions. Technical Leadership:Act as a subject matter expert, mentoring junior team members and driving engineering best practices.Required Skills & Qualifications Programming & Data:Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL. Big Data & Cloud:Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Apache Spark, and Azure Databricks. Machine Learning:Deep understanding of ML workflows, model evaluation techniques, and statistical modeling. MLOps:Practical experience with MLflow and fundamental MLOps principles (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and monitoring). Generative AI:Proven exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks (e.G., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen). Education:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.Experience Requirements Professional Experience:5–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering. Production Experience:A proven track record of deploying and maintaining ML/AI models in a production environment. Cloud Expertise:Extensive experience working within cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.About KPIT KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. We deliver end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers worldwide, shaping the future of mobility.

title: Sap Consultant
description: About the RoleThe SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.ResponsibilitiesServe as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance. Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro) Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team. Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc. Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement. Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity. Provides hands-on support to developers (e.G., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code) Other job duties and projects as assigned.QualificationsBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data GovernanceRequired SkillsStrong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S. Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems. Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF) Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions. Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions. Provide regular reports on system health and performance. Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now. Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.Preferred SkillsSAP MDG Certification

Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil. We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members. The RoleWe're hiring a Junior Data Analyst to join our growth and product analytics team. description: Exciting New Career Opportunity:Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure Company:Hirebus Location:Remote in Brazil Pay:$30K-$60K per yearWe're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.The role Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often. Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it. Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type:Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.The Role As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team You'll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You'll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense's growth.Responsibilities Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals. Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints. Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments. Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions. Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity. Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders. Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies. Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices. Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments. Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup. Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements. Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams. Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.About You 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.G., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar). Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred;
Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable). Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery. Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets. SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models. Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders. Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Solid technical foundation, including experience with: JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have;
strong preference for hands-on exposure) REST APIs and platform integrations Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes) Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT). Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns. Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts. Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2B). Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience). Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities.

Your influence will shape the future of our web platforms, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and security. In this dynamic position, you'll have the opportunity to drive technological excellence, mentor a high-performing team, and play a key role in transforming business goals into cutting-edge digital experiences. Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures. Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions. Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope. Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation. Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work. Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements. Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards. Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements. Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges. Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices. Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership. Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.Required Skills and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management. 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development. Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team. Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment. Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development. Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls. Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings. Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers. Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity. Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Data Scientist – Quant
description:
Data Scientist Sênior – Quant (Quantitative Researcher | Alpha & Investment Strategies) Se você já pensa como um investidor quantitativo e não precisa "aprender finanças no trabalho", essa oportunidade é para você. Você atuará na interseção entre rigor estatístico e tomada de decisão em investimentos, sendo responsável por pesquisar, validar e colocar em produção sinais que geram retorno real. Aqui, nenhuma ideia vai para produção sem validação profunda.Sobre o papel Você será responsável por desenvolver e evoluir estratégias quantitativas, desde a pesquisa até a aplicação em produção, garantindo robustez estatística, escalabilidade e impacto direto em decisões de investimento.Conhecimento em Finanças (não negociável)
- Factor investing: value, momentum, quality, low volatility, carry
- Construção de portfólio: mean-variance, risk budgeting, Black-Litterman

- Backtesting avançado: walk-forward, regime analysis, overfitting, Sharpe ajustado, PBO
- Microestrutura de mercado: bid-ask, market impact, execution alpha
- Derivativos: Greeks, vol surface, estrutura a termo (nível prático)Requisitos técnicos
- Mestrado ou PhD em área quantitativa (Estatística, Matemática, Física, Engenharia, CS)
- +3 anos em research quantitativo (hedge fund, asset ou prop desk)
- Python avançado: numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, scikit-learn
- Forte base em estatística: séries temporais, testes de hipótese, múltiplos testes
- Experiência com modelos fatoriais (Barra, Axioma ou próprios)
- Entendimento de execução e impacto de mercado
- Inglês fluênteDiferenciais
- Publicações acadêmicas
- Track record de estratégias em produção
- Experiência com large-scale data e otimização de portfólioAtuação: 100% remota Contratação: PJ

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Quem Somos A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo. Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de "staffing augmentation" dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.O que esperar de nós É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras;
comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.Nosso Cliente Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.Key Responsibilities Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources. Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.G., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services. Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements. HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control. Automation and Scripting: Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure. HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance. CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.G., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build). DevOps and Monitoring: Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.G., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.G., Kubernetes). Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.G., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments. Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.G., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly. Data and Analytics: Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.G., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads. Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.G., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications. Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.G., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines. Cloud Architecture: Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions. Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.G., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications. API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.G., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.Required Qualifications Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team. Cloud Infrastructure: Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.G., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions). Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.G., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN). Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.Onde você vai trabalhar? Regime 100% Home Office.Tempo de Projeto: Tempo indeterminado.Contratação CLT + Benefícios Equipe internacional.
